summary: Deferred postback replay absorbed prorated reserve credit; invoice shows negative provisional balance and recovered adjustment
description: Issue summary: Customer reports that a prorated reserve credit expected on their finalized invoice for the period 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-07 is missing. Instead the invoice shows a negative provisional balance and a small charge labeled "recovered reserve adjustment". Impact: NimbleHealth has P1 finance review and is requesting a provisional credit and an audit of attribution. Environment: Dedicated tenant (tenant id: nimble-nh), prod us-west primary, hosted fallback enabled, reserved capacity in us-west. Observed at invoice generation for cycle ending 2026-03-07.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer runs hybrid batch job that uses cached KV warmup and a small microburst at 2026-03-06T23:45:00Z

2) During planned edge-proxy maintenance window at 2026-03-06T23:50:00Z some postbacks were queued on edge nodes and replayed at 2026-03-07T01:10:00Z with server-processed timestamp equal to replay time
3) Billing reconciler attributed usage to the 2026-03-07 hourly window (after invoice cutoff) and applied reserved proration logic across windows
4) Final invoice consumed the prorated reserve credit but the postback attribution remained in later window causing a "recovered reserve adjustment" and negative provisional line
logs: postback-reconciler: reconciler-run id=run-2026-03-07-02:12 applied attributed-window=2026-03-07T01:00:00Z to 2026-03-06 events (see reconciler job logs)
billing-service: invoice-generation job invoice-2026-03-07 created negative line item "recovered reserve adjustment" amount=-$245.00 (billing logs)
comments: 2026-03-12 10:15 - Leah Patel: Opened with customer after they found missing prorated reserve credit on finalized invoice. Customer provided screenshots of invoice line items and preliminary logs.
2026-03-12 12:02 - Marco Alvarez (Support): Acknowledged, escalated to Billing & SRE, requested S3 logs and reconciler trace. SLA first response met.
2026-03-13 09:30 - SRE (Priya Nair): Confirmed edge node replay spike during maintenance window; capturing replay UUIDs and reconciler run id for audit.

2026-03-13 14:50 - Billing (Owen Price): Found reconciler applied proration to prior-window credits but the postback attribution used replay processing timestamp; suspect ordering bug in reconciler when processing delayed postbacks.
2026-03-14 08:05 - Marco Alvarez: Running reattribution script to move affected postbacks back to original event windows; will generate provisional credit after verification.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Edge-proxy replay preserves processing timestamp instead of original event timestamp, leading reconciler to misassign hourly bucket.
Hypothesis 2: Billing reconciler's idempotency window does not handle out-of-order postbacks when reconciler-run spans invoice cutoff; credits get absorbed by later-window balancing logic.
Evidence: reconciler logs show reconciler-run id=run-2026-03-07-02:12 processed events with original_event_ts present in payload but reconciler used processed_at field to decide attribution.

Dashboards: Billing->HourlyAttribution shows spike in 01:00 window with corresponding drop in 23:00 window; reserve-credit pool shows deduction for 23:00 then readdition which netted negative provisional line.
resolution: Mitigation: Issued provisional credit of $245.00 to NimbleHealth pending full reconciliation. Documented incident temporary workaround: disable edge-proxy replay aggregation during invoice cutoff and force original_event_ts propagation.

Permanent fix: Merged PR to reconciler to prefer original_event_ts for attribution when present (see related_github_prs). Added a reconciler unit test for out-of-order postbacks and a guard to defer replayed postbacks until after attribution window if invoice cutoff is close.

Follow-up: Billing will rerun the reconciler for the affected invoice cycle to produce an adjusted invoice; finance will confirm refund or credit memo. Customer to be notified when adjustment is finalized.
resolution_status: Provisional credit issued; remediate in progress
